stories.title: Sur les traces de la Royal Pop au cœur de l'écosystème industriel de Swatch Group, du Jura à Soleure

en.title: Tracing the Royal Pop at the heart of Swatch Group's industrial ecosystem, from the Jura to Solothurn
en.summary: The Royal Pop watch, co-signed by Audemars Piguet and Swatch, continues to attract customers to Swatch stores but remains frequently out of stock. Production challenges limit availability despite strong demand.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Akute Bedrohung oder nur Hysterie? In der Debatte um die Russland-Gefahr braucht es mehr Realismus

en.title: COMMENTARY - Acute threat or mere hysteria? The Russia danger debate needs more realism
en.summary: Russia's military is engaged in Ukraine while NATO faces growing concerns about potential attacks. These concerns reflect Russia's view of itself as being at war with the entire West.

stories.title: Accueilli comme une rock star à Paris, le pape Léon XIV défie la France sur la fin de vie et la laïcité

en.title: Welcomed like a rock star in Paris, Pope Leo XIV challenges France on end-of-life issues and secularism
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV completed his first day in France at the Stade de France with approximately 80,000 young people. During his visit, the pontiff spoke against euthanasia and advocated for religion's role in public life.

stories.title: Après la liesse populaire et Notre-Dame, accueil de rock star au Stade de France pour Léon XIV

en.title: After popular celebrations and Notre-Dame, rock star welcome at the Stade de France for Leo XIV
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV concluded his first full day of pontifical visit to France with young people at the Stade de France. The day featured strong statements from the pope on societal matters following celebrations throughout Paris and at Notre-Dame.

stories.title: Le trafic ferroviaire est rétabli entre Lausanne et Fribourg après un court-circuit

en.title: Rail traffic restored between Lausanne and Fribourg after short circuit
en.summary: A technical problem temporarily interrupted rail service on the CFF Lausanne-Fribourg line between Puidoux and Vauderens and on the Lausanne-Payerne line between Puidoux and Lucens. Traffic resumed around 18:00 after several hours of disruption, though some delays may persist.

stories.title: Avec son contre-projet sur les loyers, le Conseil fédéral fâche les locataires

en.title: Federal Council counter-proposal on rent regulations angers tenants
en.summary: The Swiss Federal Council rejected a tenant association initiative on limiting abusive rents and proposed an alternative. The counter-proposal satisfies neither tenant advocates nor property owners who had hoped for more favorable provisions.

stories.title: A Neuchâtel, le Conseil d’Etat est critiqué pour son manque de vision et sa gestion de crises

en.title: In Neuchâtel, the State Council is criticized for lack of vision and crisis management
en.summary: Multiple cantonal services and institutions have faced prolonged difficulties, prompting deputies across parties to question the government's responses and criticize its long-term strategic direction.

stories.title: Le trafic CFF est rétabli entre Lausanne et Fribourg

en.title: CFF traffic restored between Lausanne and Fribourg
en.summary: A technical incident at Palézieux station disrupted rail service between Puidoux and Vauderens on the Lausanne-Fribourg line starting at 16:30. Traffic resumed around 18:30, though additional delays remain possible.

stories.title: Le Conseil fédéral propose sa solution contre les loyers abusifs, l'Asloca dénonce "un scandale"

en.title: Federal Council proposes solution against abusive rents, Asloca denounces "a scandal"
en.summary: The Swiss Federal Council rejected a tenant protection initiative on abusive rents and will present an indirect counter-proposal instead. The Swiss Tenants Association, which submitted the initiative, categorically rejected these initial proposals.

stories.title: Am Zurich Film Festival – Der «Finance Guy» geniesst Promi-Status

en.title: At Zurich Film Festival – The "Finance Guy" enjoys celebrity status
en.summary: Roman P., known as "Finance Guy," received significant attention at the opening of the Zurich Film Festival.

stories.title: La 22e édition du Zurich Film Festival accueille six productions romandes

en.title: The 22nd edition of Zurich Film Festival welcomes six Romandy productions
en.summary: Six productions from the French-speaking region of Switzerland, including five co-produced by RTS, are among nineteen Swiss films shown at the 22nd Zurich Film Festival running until October 4.

stories.title: Le POP part avec un trio pour tenter de briguer un siège au Conseil d'Etat vaudois

en.title: The POP launches a trio to attempt to secure a seat on the Vaud State Council
en.summary: The Workers and Popular Party fields three candidates for the February election to the Vaud State Council. Céline Misiego, Vincent Keller, and Anaïs Timofte represent the party's candidacy.

stories.title: Verschärfung der Lex Koller: Schweizer Pensionskassen könnten Milliarden verlieren

en.title: Tightening of Lex Koller: Swiss pension funds could lose billions
en.summary: The National Council aims to restrict foreign investor access to the Swiss real estate market more severely, including real estate stocks and funds. The changes could significantly impact pension funds and private investors.

stories.title: Exklusive Daten zeigen: Die Klage über die Prämienlast ist übertrieben

en.title: Exclusive data show: Complaints about premium burden are exaggerated
en.summary: Swiss health insurance premiums rise annually, but new data indicate the financial burden remains manageable for households across all income levels.

stories.title: In der Schweiz ist Sprit doppelt so teuer wie in den USA oder Japan – ein Grund sind die Steuern

en.title: In Switzerland, fuel is twice as expensive as in the USA or Japan – taxes are one reason
en.summary: Swiss drivers pay among the world's highest prices for petrol and diesel. High wage and infrastructure costs partially explain the difference, alongside taxes.

stories.title: Australien beschränkt Vergabe von Backpacker-Visa – auch Schweizer Zuwanderer sind betroffen

en.title: Australia restricts issuance of backpacker visas – Swiss migrants are also affected
en.summary: Australia's government has suspended visa applications from 23 countries, including Switzerland. The restrictions threaten labour shortages in hospitality, agriculture, and healthcare sectors.

stories.title: Wohlstand, ohne zu arbeiten: Elon Musk will die Vision von Karl Marx verwirklichen

en.title: Prosperity without work: Elon Musk wants to realize Karl Marx's vision
en.summary: The tech billionaire believes technological progress will soon create abundance for humanity, making the left-wing ideal of unconditional basic income a reality.
